[Reused from the 1968-1971 Torino verification.] The 1970 Ford Torino brochure (Form 5105) says the Fairlane 500 offers 'six optional V-8's ranging from the 302 2V all the way up to the 429 4V Cobra Jet Ram-Air'.

caveats: All Ford Motor Co. material (brochures, owner's manuals, AMA specification sheets) counts as one source per engine-year. 1955-1959 have no NHRA data. Those entries need three non-NHRA sources: Ford literature, Over-Drive Magazine (Ford-AMA-based fact sheets), The Classic Ford (archived), Wikipedia and Old Cars Weekly. Wikipedia confirms displacement for most years but prints hp only for some engines. 1956-57 Fairlanes did not offer the 272 V-8 (Ford spec pages give it to the Mainline/Customline and Custom/Custom 300). 1968-1970 entries are reused from verify_ford-torino-1968-1971.json. Over-Drive has no 1962-1964 Fairlane sheet. Those years rest on NHRA, Ford literature, Wikipedia and Old Cars Weekly.
